Includes subdomain URLs in URL map discovery; page has 1 local and 1 subdomain link

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'allow_subdomains' => true, 'max_depth' => 0, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.map_urls(engine, url)
puts result.urls.length.inspect
```
